title: Pump inspection
text: Inspect the pump for abnormal vibration and record the reading before scheduling maintenance.

title: Maintenance permit
text: Maintenance work requires an approved permit and confirmation of energy isolation by authorized personnel.

title: Fictional restricted note
text: The fictional pump R17 vibration limit is 4 millimeters per second; review the equipment manual before action.

title: Shift handover
text: Record open maintenance requests and unresolved alarms during shift handover.
